description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) for four different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) configurations as the number of queries used during inference increases from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S),” is linear and spans from 1 to 10, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” is also linear and ranges from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. The plot displays four lines: a black solid line for “DPR w/o query,” a red line with circular markers for “DPR w/ corpus expansion,” a green line with triangular markers for “DPR w/ document expansion,” and a blue line with star markers for “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion.” The black line remains flat at approximately 34.4 throughout the range. The red line starts at approximately 35.1, rises to a peak of about 35.6 at x=2, then slightly declines to around 35.7 at x=10. The green line begins near 34.9, fluctuates slightly, and ends near 34.9. The blue line starts at about 34.8, rises to a peak of approximately 35.0 at x=2, then declines steadily to about 34.4 at x=10.
